english.title: Scheme operator fail to make application to register producer or authorised representative

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the operator of a scheme, failed to make an application, in a form that was as accurate and complete as reasonably possible, to register **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),

(A)_[a producer]_
(B)_[an authorised representative]_

who became a member of the scheme after 15th November **(..SPECIFY YEAR..), being the year immediately preceding the commencement of the relevant compliance period, to the appropriate authority within 28 days of the date when that

(C)_[producer]_
(D)_[authorised representative]_

became a member of the scheme
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 26(2), 90(3)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
